subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Place value (numbers to 999)
source.subtopic: Decompose numbers into multiples of hundreds, tens and ones up to 700 (weeks 1-2), 900 (weeks 5-6) and 999 (weeks 9-10)

show.line: 999 is the biggest three digit number. Nine hundreds, nine tens, nine ones. One more makes one thousand!

rounds.prompt: Tap the number that is 800 plus 70 plus 5.
Break up 904. Which cards show it?
rounds.praise: Yes! Nine hundred and four. No tens.

rounds.prompt: What is the nine worth in 893? Say the number.
Which number has eight hundreds, no tens and six ones?
Add one each time. 997, 998, 999. What comes next?
Sort the cards into hundreds, tens and ones.

hints: Hundreds, tens, ones. Read each digit in its place.
999 and one more is 1000, four digits.

beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! 900 and 2 is 902. 920 needs a 20 card.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's build it together. 900, 20, and no ones. 920!

parent_line: Can break numbers up to 999 into hundreds, tens and ones.
